scope: Proposition 18.3 (Terminal avoidance and local comparison) of the manuscript “The hypercube Ramsey number has linear order” (preprints/The-hypercube-Ramsey-number-has-linear-order-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 171 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7d4b26e897038267), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 156. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The terminal requirements admit simultaneous conditioning on avoidance. Each bad requirement has probability at most n−PTs/3 before conditioning, also after any one global slot pin. Under the resulting law, nonnegative tests on the stated unions of local regions have upper comparison with unconditioned initial sampling at a multiplicative cost tending to one.
